desc:
🥚 Deep-sea fish eggs... then run!

Train on your rowing machine to get faster, cross the safety zone line, and take your boat out to sea. Plunge your claw into the water: the deeper it goes, the bigger the egg will be. But each zone has a guardian, and he wants that egg!

🦈 Escape to the safety zone before the guardian catches you
🐣 Hatch your eggs at your base: their rarity remains hidden until they hatch
💰 Your animals earn money every second, even when you’re away
🚤 Buy faster machines, more powerful boats (luck and damage), and a larger enclosure
🌊 10 zones, from the Sweetwater River to the origin of the cosmos
📖 110 animals to collect in your index, with a secret animal in every zone
📏 Eggs ranging from small to cosmic
👹 Sea bosses: team up with the entire server to take them down

6 players per server, one base for each player.

CODE : RELEASE & FIXBUG
